correctness.rationale: Conditioning on N=n gives r_k=p_k H_k with H_k=w_1+w_2(S_k+S_{k+1})+R_k where survival S_k=P(X>=k), p_k=S_k-S_{k+1}. For S_k<=1/2, every n>=3 remainder contribution obeys n S_k^{n-1}<=3 S_k^2, uniformly over all N laws even E[N]=infinite. Poisson tail S_k/p_k→1, S_{k+1}/p_k→0, and p_k/p_{k-1}→0 imply H_{k-1}H_{k+1}-H_k² = w_1w_2 p_{k-1}(1+o(1)). Exact Poisson three-term ratio is k/(k+1), yielding stated positive curvature. N=1 is Poisson ULC equality; N=2 factor (S_k+S_{k+1}) is log-concave by convolution of two log-concave sequences, giving deterministic ULC. Positive mixtures excluded by asymptotic. Independent finite mpmath evaluations at lambda=2.1/w1=.57 show normalized tail/asymptotic ratios approach 1 (e.g. k=12: 0.972, k=30:0.995). Numerics only corroborate analytic proof.
